balls.text: Jaiswal takes RR to 150! Shardul does not cover himself in glory here. Full toss outside off and Jaiswal thumps it over extra cover. A stunning, stunning effort by Jaiswal - 77 off 32 is extraordinary!
another wide! Hung up a mile outside off. Jaiswal does not blink this time and lets it go. More exercise for the umpire!
innovation at its best! Slower ball bashed into the track outside off. Jaiswal knows the line that is coming and shimmies across, lapping it past the keeper!
Shardul appeals, but the umpire says no! Superb ball. Into the blockhole outside off. Jaiswal cannot get his bat down in time and only scrapes a piece of the turf on the way

banged in short outside off and this seems to balloon over the batter's head. Jaiswal swishes and misses, but then sees the square leg umpire stretch out his arms. But now MI want to review. This seems like a futile review. No bat involved and the ball is clearly above the head. 21cm, to be precise. On we go!
clever, clever batting! This is a proper buffet ball. Rank full toss wide outside off. Jaiswal opens his bat face and steers it to short third's left!
into the blockhole outside off. Hetmyer cannot get under this either and he tugs it to long on. Just a single this time

nails the length on the wide yorker but this seems to be just beyond the tramlines. Hetmyer lets it go and the umpire thinks it is fine too. Hetmyer does not and he reviews. Hetmyer did seem to move a little to the off side. The guideline also moves a little subsequently. But this is still beyond that new guideline. Decision overturned!
length ball hung up outside off. Hetmyer swings at it with all his might and drags it enough to long on's left to scamper back for two. A direct hit and Jaiswal was well short, though
off-pace and into the track on leg stump. Hetmyer chalks it right off the toe-end and the ball squirms past the bowler. The batters contemplate two but opt against it
another slower bumper and Hetmyer has no clue about this. He swings like a rusty gate and swings too early. Another fresh-air shot
good comeback by Bumrah. Right in the blockhole outside off and Jaiswal clinks it down to long off
watch this ball fly! Bumrah misses the yorker on middle, and Jaiswal does not miss his mark. Pace-on and Jaiswal goes through the line to smash it over Bumrah's head!

slower ball banged in short outside off. Jaiswal shapes for the upper-cut but has no pace to work with. Too early into the stroke but he does get bailed out by the wide call. Wide on height, to be specific
brilliant yorker on middle and off. Hetmyer can only dig it out towards point. Just a single off the first two balls of the penultimate over
slower bumper, pitches just outside leg and snakes away to the off side. Hetmyer cannot pick it up in time and lets it go
back of a length outside off. Hetmyer goes back and taps it just behind point to keep strike

holes out to long on this time, and Ghazanfar has another wicket! This is flatter and perhaps fuller outside off. Parag looks to repeat the dose and cloths it flat towards long on. Regulation chance for Tilak, and RR lose their skipper!
fetch this, says Parag! Flighted up and right in the slot outside off. Parag winds up and launches it over long on!
back of a length outside off. Parag looks to go inside-out and chunks it off the inside edge into the keeper's pad. Another vital dot
length ball jammed into the pads. Jaiswal swings at it and picks out short fine leg. Has to stay content with a single
Jaiswal's hitting spree continues! Floated up into the slot just outside off. Jaiswal plants his front foot and muscles it over the bowler's head!

pushed over the fence! Juicy and gentle full toss on the stumps. Parag tries to hit it too hard and shanks it off the lower half of the bat. That brings Shardul into play at deep mid wicket. He reaches out over his shoulder and only gets a feeble hand to it. Cannot haul it in, and Parag has his first maximum!
excellent wide yorker. Sneaks just inside the tramline and by then, Parag has decided to let it go. Top bowling
full and following the batter a mile outside leg. Jaiswal has a tug at it and chips it down to long on
gets to fifty in style! Short and wide, and bowled from over the wicket. Jaiswal goes back and across before cracking it through point. A 23-ball fifty for Jaiswal!
angled in on a length on leg. Parag looks to whip it away but is late on the stroke. Ball dribbles off the pad into the on side
full toss on middle and off. Jaiswal cannot react quick enough and drives it to long off
very full outside off. Jaiswal cannot get under it and scuffs it out towards extra cover
another slower bumper outside off. Gets up to near the head and Parag shovels it towards deep square leg
nicely done! Back of a length just outside off. Parag jams down on it very late and glides it fine past the keeper. Almost off the toe-end but the bat angle was perfect for finding the gap!
slower bumper just outside off. Jaiswal rocks back and hacks it to deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Jaiswal waits on it and runs it down to short third. He wants the single but his captain says no. Jaiswal not best pleased
hard length just outside off. Parag gets a half stride in before tapping it to long on
over the top again! Tries to hide it full outside off but Jaiswal reads those intentions. He goes through the line and pops it over extra cover!
fired in full outside off. Parag comes forward and drives it to long off to open his account

rapped on the back leg, and Jurel has to walk! Fizzed through on a back of a length on middle and leg. Skids on and Jurel is trapped on the crease. Seems to get pinged right in front and he seems happy to walk off initially but then he has a change of heart and reviews. If he has not hit this, it could be curtains. No bat involved. Ball Tracking returns three reds, and Jurel has to go, and he takes a review along with him too!
back of a length delivery hung up wide outside off. Jurel has a big swish at it but only grabs a handful of fresh air
back of a length on middle and off. Jurel reads it off the pitch and bunts it between deep mid wicket and deep square. Back for a brace
back of a length on middle and leg. Jaiswal opens up his stance and heaves it to deep mid wicket
speared in a mile outside leg. Left alone and called a wide, unsurprisingly

caught on the fence, and Sooryavanshi's party is over! Shardul reaffirming those golden arm credentials. This is full outside off and Sooryavanshi absolutely laces it. The only problem, though, is that he hits it too flat and too near deep cover. Tilak leaps high to his left and completes the catch. Sooryavanshi is distraught as he walks off, but he has done his job, and given this crowd a show to remember!
this is another stunning hit! Back of a length outside off. Sooryavanshi stands up on his toes and thumps it into the sightscreen!
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Jaiswal sits deep in his crease and cuts it towards sweeper cover
banged in short outside off. Sooryavanshi has a jab at it and nearly chops it onto his stumps. Bobbles past the stumps and towards the keeper
four more! Off-pace this time but again in the slot outside off. Sooryavanshi throws everything at it and lifts it over extra cover!
hello Shardul, says Sooryavanshi! Right in the slot outside off. Sooryavanshi plants his front foot, goes through the line and carves it over cover!
just four off the over! Slower ball hung up full outside off. Jaiswal looks to be funky but does not get the purchase he wants from his scoop. Off the glove and on the bounce to the keeper
back of a length just outside off. No room to work with for the batter and he pushes it towards deep mid wicket
hard length just outside off. Jaiswal gets up on his toes and hacks it to long on
short and wide outside off. Sooryavanshi reaches out for it and cuts it towards deep point
into the blockhole on the pads. Jaiswal tucks it off his toes towards deep backward square leg
well well! Dug in short outside off. Jaiswal walks across, trying to scoop it. Ball gets too big on him, though, and he fails to lay bat on ball
back of a length outside off. Jaiswal gives himself room and drills it towards mid off, where Hardik pulls out all the stops to his left to rein it in. Saved three there
back of a length just outside off. Sooryavanshi stands tall and punches it to long on
back of a length delivery hung up wide outside off. Sooryavanshi swishes at it and misses, and gets the wide call too
this is the biggest of the lot! Video game batting this! Shortish and sliding into the pads. Sooryavanshi uses the angle and hoicks it over deep backward square leg!
zipped in much fuller on the pads. Jaiswal digs it out towards mid wicket and pinches a single
pick the bones out of this one too! This is range hitting practice! Dragged down outside off. Jaiswal rocks back and belts it over deep square leg!
Boult travels too! Full and slanting into the pads. Jaiswal picks it up early, uses his wrists and clips it over deep backward square leg!
slower full toss outside leg. Sooryavanshi has to wait for it and gently flicks it to mid wicket

knee-high full toss down leg. Sooryavanshi is taken aback by it and helps it towards short fine leg. Sets off for a single, only to be sent back, and in trying to regain his ground, he steps onto the stumps. All happening here!

Sooryavanshi goes massive again! This is hitting of the highest order, and against the highest-quality bowler out there. Off-pace and into the track just outside off. Sooryavanshi picks it up and dumps it over deep square leg!
slower ball on a length on middle and off. Jaiswal turns it into the square leg region and gets the teenager back on strike
off-pace on a back of a length on leg. Sooryavanshi tucks it into the mid wicket region and gets off strike
oh goodness gracious me - what is this kid made of?! In the slot on middle and leg, shaping in slightly. Bowled at 131.2kph and Sooryavanshi nonchalantly whips it over mid on!
22 off the opening over! Jaiswal showing he can tee off from the start too. Full just outside off. Jaiswal gives himself a bit of room and cracks it past extra cover!
four more! Juicy full toss just outside off. Jaiswal clears his front leg and bangs it over the bowler's head!
very full on leg stump. Jaiswal tucks it off his pads towards mid wicket and that is a rare dot
over the off side now! Chahar being torn apart! Full and wide. Jaiswal throws the kitchen sink at it and flays it over backward point!
Jaiswal goes all the way now! Back of a length on middle and off. Jaiswal stands up tall again and wallops it over mid wicket!
and the action begins! Half-tracker outside off. Sits up nicely outside off and Jaiswal opens up his front hip to smack it past mid wicket!

on the bounce to Hetmyer, but it does not matter in the grand scheme. RR win and they win at a canter! Slower short ball outside off. Chahar swishes at it and slices it towards sweeper cover. RR go 3-0 and MI, after beginning their campaign with a win, have now been subjected to successive defeats!
slower bumper outside off. Bumrah loads up and heaves it between long on and deep mid wicket. Back for a brace
Bumrah with a boundary too! Banged in short and wide. Bumrah reaches out for it and uses the pace to glide it over backward point!
very full on middle and off. Chahar cannot do much with it and powers it down the ground to long on
slower ball on a back of a length on middle and leg. Chahar has a mow across the line and only swats away a few flies in the process

Boult has been run out! Sizzling yorker on middle and leg. Boult squeezes it out towards the bowler. Chahar calls him through for the single but there was very little chance Boult would make it. Archer fields it on his follow-through, takes aim and throws down the stumps at his end!
short, wide and put away! Ample width on offer and Chahar frees his arms, slicing it over backward point. Deep point cannot get to it either!
shortish outside off. Boult opens up his front hip and hacks it to long on

goes a mile up, and Jurel does the rest again! Back of a length on off. Holds up a little in the surface and Shardul is far too early into his tug. The ball goes nowhere and Jurel, taking a few forward paces, sends Shardul back to the shed!
too wide again, and this is not great bowling, especially with the game more or less in the bag. More extras for MI
well done on the fence! Length ball outside off. Shardul winds up and launches it over the bowler's head. Jaiswal hustles to his right from long off and cuts it off

off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Shardul swings his blade like an axe and misses. Called a wide but RR want to check it. And they might have a case too. The ball is inside the tramlines, and the decision has been overturned!
full toss speared down leg. Shardul misses it but this time, the umpire opts to indulge in some exercise
length ball hung up wide outside off. Shardul has a wild swish at it and misses the ball by a fair distance
more runs! Not off the bat, though. Angled in on a length on leg. Chahar fails to make contact and the ball brushes the thigh pad before dribbling away past the keeper!

catching practice for long on again! On a length on middle and off. The angle from around the wicket, though, cramps Dhir just a shade, much like Hardik earlier in the evening. Arrows it straight down Bishnoi's throat, and MI are now seven down!
over short third again! Back of a length and wide outside off. Dhir peels the outer cover off the ball and scythes it away!
back of a length outside off. Dhir reaches out for it and scuffs it towards extra cover
Very full on middle and off. Shardul cannot get under this and drills it to long on
Smart batting! Back of a length on middle and off. Shardul moves across his stumps early and scoops it over short fine!
Slower low full toss outside off. Shardul way too early into the stroke and slices it off the toe-end towards short third. On the bounce to Burger, who does well to his right to keep it to one

has that carried?! That is an astonishing catch if it has! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Rutherford swishes hard at it and the ball flies off the outside edge towards short third. Sandeep lunges forward and seems to pick it up inches off the turf. Replays confirm it. Sensational grab, and Rutherford's rear-guard action has come to an end!
six more! Rutherford is making MI believe! Knee-high full toss on the pads. Rutherford gets inside the line and clubs it over deep backward square leg!
Slower bumper on leg. Rutherford watches the ball balloon over his head. Called a wide
Rutherford with an enormous hit!
zipped in full outside off. Dhir looks to go downtown and shanks it to long on
begins the over with a boundary! Slower ball banged in short outside off. Dhir jumps up onto his toes and ramps it over short third!
four more! Wrong'un on a fullish length outside off. Rutherford comes forward, gets his hands through the ball and lifts it over extra cover!
through the gap! Googly on a back of a length outside off. Rutherford waits on it and knifes it between short third and backward point!
short and wide outside off. Dhir cuts it towards deep point
googly on a back of a length on middle and leg. Rutherford plonks it uppishly past the bowler
sprayed a mile outside off. Left alone and called a wide
googly on a back of a length on the pads. Rutherford tucks it with enough pace to deep mid wicket, and saunters back for another brace
skewed off the toe-end and put down! Googly on a fullish length outside off. Rutherford wants to go over long off but miscues it completely. Jaiswal runs in from long off but grasses it
full on middle and leg. Dhir checks his drive and chips it over the bowler's head for a couple of runs
edged and four! Length outside off. Dhir looks to go downtown but gets it 180 degrees in the other direction. Off the outside edge, and between the keeper and short third!

a direct hit and Rutherford was not even in the frame! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Dhir chalks it off the toe-end towards point. Rutherford hares down, only to be sent back. He had given up!
clean strike! Half-tracker outside off. Sits up and Dhir has all the time in the world to whack it flat over the wide long on fence!
back of a length just outside off. Dhir comes forward and punches it to long on. Jaiswal fumbles and ends up conceding the second
back of a length just outside off and this skids through. Dhir cannot adjust in time and the ball squirms under the toe-end of his bat

Tilak falls too, and MI are crumbling in the far east! Floated up a little more, on a fullish length just outside leg. Tilak thinks this is there to be smashed but the bat face closes upon impact. Shanked straight to deep mid wicket, and Bishnoi has two in the same over, yet again!
right in the gap! Googly dropped short just outside off. Tilak picks it early, rocks back and shovels it between long on and deep mid wicket!
googly on a fullish length on the pads. Dhir comes forward and dinks it to deep mid wicket

slapped straight to Jaiswal at long on, and Bishnoi is doing his thing again! Googly on a length on middle. Spins in a touch and that seems to cramp Hardik ever so slightly. He cannot free his arms fully and hits it flat to Jaiswal, who gobbles up the chance smartly to his left. MI reeling!
shot! Back of a length outside off. Sits up and Hardik, standing still, bludgeons it past extra cover. That flew to the fence!
into the blockhole on leg. Tilak jams it out into the mid wicket region and has to settle for a single
back of a length outside off. Tilak reaches out for it and scuffs it towards sweeper cover
another slower bumper outside off. Sails over the batter's head and bounces just before the keeper, causing a fumble. Just a bye, though. Not called a wide again
slower short ball wide outside off. Hardik throws his hands at it but only connects with the moist Guwahati air
shot! Length outside off and Hardik climbs into it. He transfers his weight forward and crashes it between mid off and extra cover!
miscued but safe! Banged in short outside off. Tilak tries to fight the angle and splices his pull. Gets just enough to clear mid on
greeted with a boundary! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Tilak spots the variation early and smears it over mid on!
back of a length on middle. Tilak lets the ball come to him before knocking it to long on. Just three off the over. Magnificent stuff!
back of a length, sneaking down leg. Tilak swings and misses, and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
back of a length, following the batter just outside leg. Tilak can only play it back to the bowler
fullish just outside off. Hardik leans into the drive and punches it crisply towards mid off. Good work by Parag to his left to keep it to one

pinned on the boot, and that is plumb with a capital P! Rohit does not think so, though. Zipped into the blockhole on off. Rohit shapes for the scoop. Goes too far across and then cannot access the ball. If there is no bat involved, this could be a terrible review. No bat involved. Ball Tracking comes up and...it shows the ball to be thundering into the stumps. Rohit takes a review along with him, and this chase is in tatters!
top yorker outside off. Rohit jams his bat down on it just in time and digs it out towards short third
length outside off. Rohit has a waft at it and slices it towards backward point
hard length, tucking up the batter on leg. Tilak, after charging, has to re-adjust and pats it back to the bowler
fullish just outside off. Tilak reaches out for it in front and chunks it off the inside half of the bat behind square. Off the mark with a brace

straight to the fielder, and Burger has a scalp too! He is thoroughly pumped as well. Banged in short outside leg. Seems like a change-up too and SKY cannot generate the power he wants. Could not have picked out Archer better at deep backward square leg, and MI's chase is wobbling early!
back of a length in the channel. SKY gets squared up and prods it towards backward point
back of a length delivery sliding down leg. SKY does not get bat on it and the umpire calls it a wide
right then! SKY has arrived! Length ball outside leg. SKY gets down on one knee in a flash and paddles it over the fine leg fence!
back of a length outside off. Rohit rises with the bounce and eases it past Sooryavanshi at cover point, who ends up diving over it. Cut off eventually and kept to three

straight up the chimney, and taken! Hard length just outside off. Rickelton has a swipe across the line but the ball moves away just enough to cause the miscue. Skews up a mile and Jurel does well to call everyone off. Settles under it in the short third region and makes no mistake. RR on the board early!
Rickelton lands his first punch! On a length on leg and away it goes. Rickelton plants his front foot and whips it over deep mid wicket!
angled in full on middle and off. Rohit brings his wrists into play and flicks it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
back of a length on leg. Seams away a touch and Rickelton gets squared up slightly. Plonked into the extra cover region
zipped in full outside off. Rohit looks to go downtown and jams it off the inside edge into his pad. Rolls away into the off side for a single
back of a length just outside off. Rickelton gets up on his toes and drops it just behind point to get off the mark
